title: [FancyZones] Identical monitors get the same serial number, so layouts swap or reset

status.label: Actionable fix candidate
status.detail: Issue identifies a current-source defect: WMI serial assignment matches monitor records only by model-code deviceId.id, so identical displays may receive the same serial and collapse persisted layout identity.

plan: Use per-instance/device identity rather than only model code.
Define deterministic fallback for missing/duplicate serials.
Test identical models with different instances and missing serials.
